name: Nekomimi Musume Choukyou S
source:
Teacher entrusts main character to train a cat girl within two weeks. Will protagonist succeed? And what personality will cat girl embrace - nasty one or gentle one?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
老师委托主人公，在两周内将一名猫娘训练好。他能成功吗？猫娘最后又会形成怎样的性格——恶劣，还是温顺？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
